'''Chris Mortonson Jabba's Dagobah Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Chris Mortonson]]
* '''Published:''' June 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Swamp|Dagobah-L-dagobahswamp.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jabba's Dagobah Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PJP Jabba's Dagobah Deck Mortonson LS.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

'''Intro:''' In my opinion, using a Dagobah deck against a deck containing Jabba's Palace cards, such as Cane Adiss, is a bit of a gamble. But you're taking a gamble anyway, right? The basic premise of this deck is simple - get a presence out in space while testing Luke.

== Strategy ==

Conclusion: O.K. this deck is plain and simple (kind of). All you really need to do is to get a presence out in space while testing Luke.

In case of an attack, just use landing claws. Then, when you have the chance, you make a Kessel run or two from Corellia. You can drain at Dagobah, Kessel or the incinerator. Use EG-4 with his destiny of 0 for those Off the Edges. You could also attack a small Force left somewhere with your ships. Put Chewie and Han on the Falcon and you get 4 destinies (with life Debit) and a total power of 8, not to mention that it is immune to attrition less than 5. Use the Ithorian for extra Force drain at a Dagobah site. Use the Senses mostly for protection.
